description: Set one verse or range side by side in several Bible editions or languages (e.g. kjv, web, greek-nt, hebrew), aligned verse by verse, with a word-level summary of how two English editions differ; or one paragraph of a work in each of its languages (original, English, and a third language where there is one). Every row has its permanent link and citation.

editions.description: Bible editions or languages, e.g. ["kjv","web"] or ["hebrew","lxx","en"]; for a work, languages such as ["grc","en"]. Default: the original and two English editions.

id.description: The work: its id or address name from search_shelf (e.g. "plato-republic"), or a scriptura.si link.

paragraph.description: Paragraph, counted from 1 as read_work counts ("p-3", the page anchor, also works).

ref.description: A Bible reference ("John 1:1", "PSA.23.1-3") or any reference resolve_ref reads.

url.description: A scriptura.si link to a verse or paragraph.

name: compare_translations

cite.description: Ready citation naming Scriptura, ending with the link.
Ready citation naming Scriptura, ending with the link.

error.description: What went wrong, in plain words.

resource.description: The same passage as a scriptura:// resource, readable as Markdown with resources/read.

title: Compare translations
